kernel_evidence.caveat: ATT stall shares are qualitative single-CU samples; unsupported all-zero counters are unavailable, not measured zero.

evidence: Q4_K production spends 96.31% of sampled decoded stall cycles at global-load waits.
Quantized weight GEMVs account for 73.852 ms of the 83.890 ms recorded GPU trace.
The supported timing and wave evidence is consistent across the same-run ablation.
missing_evidence: FetchSize, MemUnitBusy, derived occupancy, and raw cache counters are unavailable on this ROCm/gfx1201 combination.

limit_estimate.conclusion: The production path already uses a substantial fraction of peak bandwidth and is dominated by load wait, so reducing compulsory packed-weight bytes has a clearer ceiling than instruction-only tuning.
assumptions: Each scoped packed weight is streamed once per decoded token.
640 GB/s is a peak roof, not a guaranteed sustained application bandwidth.
ATT evidence is qualitative; the estimate relies on supported kernel timings and packed byte counts.

observed_evidence: The production Q4_K decode path is dominated by quantized GEMV and global-load wait.
Q4_RDNA packs the scoped weights in 11.30% fewer bytes.
hypothesis.interpretation: Reducing packed weight traffic could improve a memory-bound decode path.
hypothesis.proposed_change: Use the fixed 4.25 bpw Q4_RDNA representation with one lane owning a full K-length row.
hypothesis.expected_performance_signature: Lower target GEMV time and higher decode tokens/s.
risks: The mapping may launch too few waves and serialize long accumulation chains.
hypothesis.stop_condition: Reject if repeatable decode throughput does not exceed the baseline.

observed_evidence: The old mapping is 36% slower end to end.
It launches only 32 to 384 waves for representative matrices and spends more stall cycles in VALU/dependency than the split mapping.
hypothesis.interpretation: Device-wide wave supply and a long per-lane accumulation chain limit the old mapping, rather than the packed representation itself.
hypothesis.proposed_change: Keep the same sidecar and binary, remove the old-mapping override, and cooperatively split K across wave32 lanes.
hypothesis.expected_performance_signature: Launch 8x to 32x more waves and reduce target GEMV duration without changing representation or quality coordinates.
hypothesis.expected_e2e_effect: At least 10% higher decode throughput than Q4_K_M.
risks: Small systematic quality loss from the fixed representation
hypothesis.stop_condition: Reject if throughput gain is below 10% or the explicit quality budget is exceeded.

change.description: Use cooperative split-K wave32 mapping with identical sidecar and binary
